findings.finding: Media constructs a capture source and an optional media source; media folders are added when onboarding is enabled.
SourceFolder all-cases array contains Downloads, Desktop, Documents and Screenshots/screen recordings.
Media maps these four SourceFolders to LibrarySource.media directory cases.
Media query initializes a builder, sets limit 0x32 (50), sets sources, and builds the query.
The limit method writes query.limit and marks the optional limit present.
The shared file query enumerates direct children only and filters media using UTType.image or UTType.movie.
